grammar.title: Pronomes Reflexivos (by myself, enjoy myself)
rules: Pronomes reflexivos (myself, yourself, himself, herself, ourselves, themselves) indicam que o sujeito pratica e recebe a ação.
"by + reflexivo" significa "sozinho, sem ajuda": I traveled by myself.
"enjoy/express/find + reflexivo" são expressões fixas comuns: enjoy yourself, express yourself, find yourself.
Combinações com verbos: teach yourself, trust yourself, be yourself, make yourself at home.
